description: Functional specification/files: add a presentation-owned helper that reads the existing Global settings global base URL through the canonical System API and composes the fixed /people/credentials destination, preserving deployment prefixes and normalizing trailing slashes. Accept safe absolute HTTP(S) URLs only; on missing/invalid configuration omit the link and provide administrator guidance. Include no IDs, secrets, provider payloads, redirect parameters or login handling; authentication and post-login return are explicitly out of scope and owned by the separate login worktree. Tests before implementation: table/property tests for prefix/trailing slash and unsafe/missing URL rejection plus personal-vs-global link eligibility. Branches: valid URL, missing URL, malformed scheme/host/userinfo/query/fragment/control/traversal. Mocking: none; inject/configure the canonical base URL seam without global mutation. Docs: Channels recovery-link contract. Action reuse: REUSE Zaq.System.get_global_base_url/0; local-only deterministic URL composition, not a new Action/tool. Verify no BO direct call or new credential-management path.
title: [zaq-jrg.48] Compose safe People credential recovery links
